results.evidence: A 2020 trip report calls the base 'only a 5 minute walk from the car', and the area description has the first wall visible through the trees above the boulder field at the parking spot, which supports a very short approach; but no second source states an approach time or distance, and no source states a total gain for this route. Setting high_point_ft to the base elevation follows the catalog's crag-route convention. The two pins share one coordinate, though, and the 4,800 ft topout is below the 4,916 ft base. The Full Montey (upper bench) area is listed at 4,916 ft and the crag area as a whole at 4,217 ft, which suggests 4,916 is the topout bench rather than the base, but no second source confirms either elevation.

No source states the aspect of the Mossness/Full Montey walls; the route's description only says it is hot in summer and best climbed early. The crag coordinate lies south of Tyler Peak's summit, which hints at a south-facing slope, but that is not a sourced aspect.
